description: Current planets in the sky and their major aspects to a natal chart. Pass the same birth fields as natal_chart. date is an optional YYYY-MM-DD; omit it for the sky right now. A date is read at 12:00 in the birth timezone.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as HH:MM, 24-hour. Omit it when the time is unknown.

date.description: Civil date for the sky, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for the current time.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees, from -89.9 to 89.9. North is positive.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180. East is positive.
